_comment: IMU balance assist for demo steps with "balance": true (see src/zbot_core/zbot_core/balance.py). Holds the torso at the tilt it had when the balanced steps began: pitch via ankle_pitch, roll via hip_yaw (lean) of the stance leg. kp/kd = joint deg per deg / per deg/s of deviation; max_deg clamps each correction, slew_dps limits how fast it changes. stance: auto (the straighter knee carries) | left | right | both. pitch_sign/roll_sign flip a joint's direction if the correction pushes the wrong way. dry_run: only log, command nothing - use it first, tilting the robot by hand.
